canonical_name: Laurent Lafforgue's global Langlands correspondence for GL_n over function fields
canonical_statement: For a global function field F and rank n, irreducible n-dimensional continuous l-adic representations of the absolute Galois group with finite-order determinant correspond to cuspidal automorphic representations of GL_n over the adeles with finite-order central character, compatibly with the unramified local Frobenius and Hecke characteristic polynomials.

domain_and_universes: A global function field F over a finite constant field, n >= 1, and an auxiliary prime l different from the characteristic; coefficient field and embeddings require an explicit convention in the statement phase.
hypotheses: continuous and irreducible on the Galois side
conclusion: A bijective correspondence with equality of characteristic/Hecke polynomials at every unramified place (subject to the source's normalization conventions).
excluded_degenerate_cases: Rank zero is excluded. Ramified-place compatibility, uniqueness normalizations, coefficient-field equivalence, and arithmetic-versus-geometric Frobenius are not silently inferred at intake.
